summary: Official Gumi City pages establish a municipal cadastral-survey/land-information procedure, while the national K-GeoP public viewer supplied a bounded anonymous parcel lookup. The exact WUP point was queried without shifting it; the service returned one address/parcel result with safe native PNU identity and a WGS84 geometry string. No retained sample is included because the response also contained many source-specific land, building, valuation and ownership-adjacent fields, and the geometry was not independently normalized into a review-safe file.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Korean first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-2789-gumi-si.json. Results identified Gumi City map/cadastral pages and the national K-GeoP viewer. The municipal map was inspected as a general map and did not expose a cadastral parcel API in its HTML/JavaScript.

requestOutcomes.outcome: 200; current municipal comprehensive-map HTML and /map/js/map.js loaded. Categories are civic facilities and services; no cadastral parcel layer or parcel endpoint was exposed in the inspected page/scripts.
200; official Gumi City cadastral-survey procedure page. It identifies land-information work and provides the cadastral-survey contact path, but is not a parcel feature service.

200; current national K-GeoP land-information viewer loaded. Its JavaScript/configuration exposed the public geopass address and parcel-information routes, WFS route configuration, and map projection EPSG:5179.

200 JSON; exact WUP longitude/latitude query returned one result: Gumi-si, Gongdan-dong 212, PNU 4719011300102120000, with parcelX/parcelY and a MULTIPOLYGON geometry in longitude/latitude order. No coordinate shift was used.

200 JSON; parcel-information response returned the same PNU plus extensive land/building/valuation/record fields. These were inspected only for schema qualification and were not retained. No owner name, owner registration number, address, contact, tax/account or other unsafe field was requested as a targeted field.
DNS resolution failed from the bounded environment; no TLS bypass or alternate host was attempted. This does not negate the successful K-GeoP application/API response above.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [36.1089634843612, 128.367049228517] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; the K-GeoP request used the equivalent longitude,latitude query parameter required by its JavaScript.
The one returned parcel is a bounded point lookup, not evidence of citywide coverage or absence outside the queried location.

The municipal Gumi map was not shown to be the parcel custodian; national K-GeoP supplied the verified parcel response. Local municipal custody is evidenced only for cadastral-survey procedure/contact, not a municipal geometry API.
The WFS host configured by the viewer was not DNS-resolvable in this environment; no layer-name/schema enumeration was completed.
No owner, titleholder, personal, contact, tax, account or other unsafe fields were requested or retained. The parcel-info response was not copied into the cohort directory.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; independent serial reviewer qualification remains required.
